name: netscoot
description: The netscoot plugin: AI-agent skills for restructuring .NET, PowerShell, Unity, and native C++ projects.

plugins.name: netscoot
plugins.description: netscoot moves .NET, PowerShell, Unity, and native C++ projects and updates every solution, project, and script that points at them, rolling back if a step fails. This plugin has your agent use it instead of hand-editing those files.
